# OANK Cleaning CIC

OANK Cleaning CIC is a cleaning service based in Paisley, Scotland. It operates as a service-area business and provides cleaning at customers' homes and workplaces. Customers are not received at a public office.

## Service area

- The whole of Renfrewshire, Scotland
- Glasgow, Scotland

## Cleaning services and published starting prices

- Regular domestic and home cleaning — from £18.50 per hour.
- Deep cleaning — from £85 for a one-off clean.
- End-of-tenancy cleaning — from £145 per package.
- Office and commercial cleaning — from £19.50 per hour on contract.
- Care home and healthcare cleaning — custom quote.
- Carpet and upholstery cleaning — from £45 per room.

Prices are starting prices and may depend on the property, scope of work and booking requirements.

## Community programmes

- OANK Home Reset: free or subsidised cleaning support for people facing difficult circumstances. The level of support depends on individual needs and circumstances.
- OANK Employment Pathway: employment and job training support connected with OANK cleaning work. Contact OANK to ask about current opportunities.
